review_notes: 62 existing definitions in eight files. Exact token checks for alpha-only edits and focused review for structured edits. No new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim; one combined incremental build.

Subtype lookup keeps fallback and changeling query order, including adjacent inst_info_data reads. Reported subtype and shared-subtype arrays use sizeof-based clears after checking the reported_subtypes_t declaration. Moonmist preserves its recovered marked-value transformation behavior.

Haakon shares casting/graveyard dispatch while retaining death-trigger calls, cost queries, cached graveyard pointers and timing reloads. Remove provably unreachable cast edges inside CAN_CAST/MODIFY_COST branches in Commandeer and Fury of the Horde. Bushido retains its special already-enabled resolution shortcut.

Shared Sliver lifecycle follows the previously reviewed shape, retaining source-instance reads, cleanup exile and humiliation calls. Reality Acid shares common callbacks and aura routing. Grand Ossuary uses ordinary counter-distribution loops with the same record snapshots, count masks, target writes, retry order and GFP early returns.

Deep Water uses indexed writes to the same seven mana-override entries per player. Frankenstein counter choice preserves the first AI choice and later RNG calls. Spitting Slug preserves the attacker path that bypasses blocking-state tests. Aether Snap uses the same 302-int snapshot and cached flags across removal/destruction callbacks.
Larger land-conversion, plane damage, modal AI and counter-related paths retain flow under exact token substitution. Full audits, inventory regeneration and reccmp deferred.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
